description:
With a name like Gravey how could you take him seriously?! Who names themselves Gravey!  

If you die over the water the enemy gets no scrap! 
Treaded units work on this map. Use a nav to force them to move into the water. Water pathing is wack.     

7 pools
60 base loose
2 secondaries but no base pools
25 scrap at north and south 3rd pools
30 scrap mid
30 scrap at side of base


Map by Gravey
